notes: Every value here is an input to model.js. Each one names a source id from sources.json, or says assumption. Change a value with a pull request and say why.

R.note: Iowa ranges 160 to 200; 180 is the middle (Jasper County)

K.note: Tama silty clay loam, a common loess soil

LS.note: Representative statewide slope factor, chosen so a corn and soybean rotation under reduced tillage lands near the measured Iowa average of 4.7 to 5.2 tons/acre/yr

T.note: Soil loss tolerance for most Iowa soils

erosion.R_trend_note: Assumption. NOAA reports more 2-inch rain days (1.5 a year long-term, 2.2 in 2015-2019) and projects heavier extremes, but gives no erosivity trend. The options bracket that.

plow_layer_in.note: Matches the 0-8 inch shallow samples in Iowa's trace element survey

subsoil_pb_mg_kg.note: National C horizon median; Iowa's own deep-sample figure would be better

deposition_velocity_cm_s.note: Typical dry deposition speed for fine particles

background_deposition_mg_m2_yr.note: Mid-1990s northeastern US rate, likely higher than rural Iowa today

manure_rate_dry_tons_ac_yr.note: Only used in the manured field scenario

corn_silage.note: Twice corn grain, because silage takes the residue off the field

oats.note: Small grain cover between row crop and meadow
